    • title

    • validWhen

      public CustomMenu.Builder validWhen(Predicate<net.minecraft.world.entity.player.Player> context)
      Who may open this menu, and for how long. A client's open request (ClientMenu.of(menu).requestOpen()) is honored only when this is declared and holds for the requesting player, checked on the server; the open menu closes when it stops holding (vanilla's stillValid, every tick). A menu tied to a block checks the player's distance to it here. Without it the menu opens only from the server (CustomMenu.open(ServerPlayer)) and stays open while the player is alive.

    • arm

      public CustomMenu.Builder arm(Runnable arm)
      Sets slot behavior for this menu. register() runs it after the MenuType and id exist, so a custom menu's slot behavior is declared in the same chain as the menu and can't be forgotten in a separate step.

      Set slot behavior by Address here; the menu's created slots have addresses as soon as it is registered (Window.slot(ModeScope.BOTH, Address.createdSlot(SlotGroupId.created(panelId, groupId), i)).set(...)). It runs at register() time on whichever side called it, since engine declarations are plain data, just like setting behavior by hand in common init. 

      CustomMenu.define(id, MyMenu::buildHandler)
    .arm(() -> {
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Window.slot(ModeScope.BOTH, Address.createdSlot(SlotGroupId.created("side", "filtered"), i))
                  .gate(diamondsOnly);
        }
    })
    .register();

    • register

      public CustomMenu register()
      Completes the registration, in common init on either side: builds and registers the MenuType, fills in the default title if none was given, stores the handle by id, and returns it. Call once at mod init.
